# aeternum_forge
giga_mega_is_aeternum_forge = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_megastructure_flag = @giga_mega_classified
        }
        has_megastructure_flag = giga_family_aeternum_forge
    }
    else = {
        or = {
            is_megastructure_type = aeternum_forge_0 # Aeternite Psykofabricator Construction Site
            is_megastructure_type = aeternum_forge_1 # Aeternite Psykofabricator
        }
    }
}
